newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hai Hong gains on hope of asset purchase.
newsitem.headline: Hai Hong gains on hope of asset purchase.

text.p: Shares of China Merchants Hai Hong Holdings Co Ltd gained on hopes the company's assets purchase plan would be finalised soon, brokers said on Tuesday.
"Market talk that it is planning to place shares at about HK$5.20 each to raise capital to fund its purchase of assets stimulated buying," said a dealing director at a regional brokerage.
The company's shares rose HK$0.25 to HK$5.80 at midday on volume of 29.91 million shares.
Brokers said no further details were known to the market yet. Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Last week, China Merchants Hai Hong said no decision had been made on the way to fund its purchase of assets from its parent, China Merchants Holdings (Hong Kong) Co Ltd.
